findings.current: Three hundred elite warriors of Nanman melted into a handful of bloody water, and two great chieftains and more than a dozen tribal chiefs were torn limb from limb.
findings.defect: The draft changes 십여 명, approximately a dozen or a little over ten, into “more than a dozen,” which specifically means at least thirteen and overstates the casualty count.
findings.rationale: The source gives an approximate count in the low teens rather than stating that the number exceeded twelve.
findings.replacement: Three hundred elite warriors of Nanman melted into a handful of bloody water, and two great chieftains and around a dozen tribal chiefs were torn limb from limb.
findings.source: 남만의 정예 전사 삼백이 한 줌 혈수(血水)로 녹아내렸고, 두 명의 대족장과 십여 명의 부족장이 사지가 찢겨 죽었다고 했다.

findings.current: No one knew at the time. No one knew that the unknown things left behind by the Five Poisons Sect were still living in the deepest reaches of Ailao Mountain.
findings.defect: The draft unnecessarily repeats “No one knew,” adding emphatic repetition absent from the source.
findings.rationale: The Korean is one continuous statement split typographically after 몰랐다, not two independently repeated declarations.
findings.replacement: No one knew at the time that the unknown things left behind by the Five Poisons Sect were still living in the deepest reaches of Ailao Mountain.
findings.source: 당시에는 누구도 몰랐다. 애뇌산 가장 깊숙한 곳에서 오독문이 남긴 알 수 없는 것들이 살아가고 있다는 것을.

findings.current: At the end of the direction my finger indicated was a dark, rugged valley like the entrance to Hell. A figure sat leaning against a tree.
findings.defect: “At the end of the direction my finger indicated” is an unnatural Korean-syntax calque.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally conveys both things visible in the direction he points without changing their positions or relationship.
findings.replacement: Ahead lay a dark, rugged valley like the entrance to Hell, with a lone figure sitting against a tree.
findings.source: 내 손가락이 향하는 방향 끝에는, 지옥의 입구처럼 어둡고 험한 골짜기와 나무에 기대어 앉아 있는 한 인영이 있었다.

findings.current: The venomous beasts and ferocious beasts, sensing danger, appeared and attacked from all directions as though possessed by Hong Gil-dong. The tribal chiefs leading the warriors feared the losses their own people would suffer.
findings.defect: The culturally specific Hong Gil-dong comparison is retained without the brief context needed for an English reader to understand the joke about appearing everywhere.
findings.rationale: The source invokes a culturally specific stock image of Hong Gil-dong appearing unpredictably in many places; the footnote preserves that comic association without replacing it with a different joke.
findings.replacement:
The venomous beasts and ferocious beasts, sensing danger, appeared and attacked from all directions as though possessed by Hong Gil-dong.[^1] The tribal chiefs leading the warriors feared the losses their own people would suffer.

[^1]: Hong Gil-dong is a legendary Korean outlaw hero proverbially said to appear here, there, and everywhere.
findings.source: 위험을 느낀 독물과 맹수들은 홍길동에 빙의된 것처럼 곳곳에서 나타나 습격을 벌였고, 전사들을 이끄는 부족장들은 자신들의 손해를 두려워했다.

findings.current: “What bastard dares to do something like this…!”
findings.defect: The draft omits 찢어 죽일, softening the Beast Miao King’s explicit threat to tear the culprit apart, and uses present tense for an atrocity that has already occurred.
findings.rationale: 찢어 죽일 conveys both intense fury and a violent threat, while 감히 refers to whoever dared commit the massacre already before him.
findings.replacement: “Which bastard dared…? I’ll tear him limb from limb!”

findings.current: A venomous beast being controlled by Dark Heaven.
findings.defect: The draft omits 애뇌산의, weakening the final hypothesis by no longer identifying the controlled creature specifically as one of Ailao Mountain’s venomous beasts.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly distinguishes an ordinary Ailao Mountain creature from an Ailao Mountain creature under Dark Heaven’s control.
findings.replacement: One of Ailao Mountain’s venomous beasts being controlled by Dark Heaven.

summary: The draft contains one altered casualty quantity, several localized omissions or additions, an inaccessible cultural joke, softened violent register, and one conspicuous Korean-syntax calque.
